entries.speaker: Ephraim Nines (R)
entries.title: Ephraim Nines (R): ""The Alliance of Nations summons Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Alliance of Nations summons Maartin van Hoorten, Prime Minister of Agnolia, to the stage."

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten (R)
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten (R): ""Good morning.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good morning."

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten (R)
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten (R): ""It is an honor to see you all in t..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is an honor to see you all in this chamber."

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten (R)
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten (R): ""The Alliance of Nations and its po..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Alliance of Nations and its position is paramount to maintaining peace in the world. It is the sole organization that can bring all of us together..."

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten (R)
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten (R): ""Thank you, President Nines.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, President Nines."

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten (R)
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten (R): ""Not only for constructive discussi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not only for constructive discussions, but for collective problem-solving."

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten (R)
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten (R): ""With our combined will and desire..."
entries.dialogueText: "With our combined will and desire for justice, there is no issue we cannot resolve."

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten (R)
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten (R): ""I therefore ask for your assistanc..."
entries.dialogueText: "I therefore ask for your assistance in the fair and just resolution of a dilemma faced by my proud nation of Agnolia."

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten (R)
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten (R): ""It concerns Helji Island.""
entries.dialogueText: "It concerns Helji Island."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""This again. We're in for an intere..."
entries.dialogueText: "This again. We're in for an interesting time."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Upon hearing the name of the island..."
entries.dialogueText: Upon hearing the name of the island, everyone in the room woke up and sprang to attention. I heard Laurento mutter under his breath.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What do you mean?""
entries.dialogueText: "What do you mean?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I kept watching the speech."
entries.dialogueText: I kept watching the speech.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""He's reigniting Agnolia's feud wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's reigniting Agnolia's feud with Valgsland. If you ask me, now is neither the time nor place."

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten (R)
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten (R): ""The innocent Agnolians living on t..."
entries.dialogueText: "The innocent Agnolians living on this island are currently living under the long shadow cast by Valgsland."

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten (R)
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten (R): ""Their territorial ambitions know n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Their territorial ambitions know no bounds. They will not rest until they have subdued every Agnolian soul on the land they have unlawfully claimed as theirs."

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten (R)
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten (R): ""I pose you this question. What wou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I pose you this question. What would you have done if it was your own land under threat?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Our eyes randomly met before he tur..."
entries.dialogueText: Our eyes randomly met before he turned his gaze away.

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten (R)
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten (R): ""The place where your great-grandfa..."
entries.dialogueText: "The place where your great-grandfather was born, where your father was born..."

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten (R)
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten (R): ""For peace in Eastern Merkopa, Helj..."
entries.dialogueText: "For peace in Eastern Merkopa, Heljiland has to be recognized as Agnolian."

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten (R)
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten (R): ""I urge you to do the right thing.""
entries.dialogueText: "I urge you to do the right thing."

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten (R)
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten (R): ""Helji Island is a vital piece of o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Helji Island is a vital piece of our heritage that Chancellor Hegel is trying to take away from us by force."

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten (R)
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten (R): ""Would you not defend it? Would you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Would you not defend it? Would you not protect it with your life?"

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten (R)
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten (R): ""Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten (R)
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten (R): ""Don't forget. If you tolerate this..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't forget. If you tolerate this happening to us, your own nations will be next."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I could see that Emmerich Hegel had..."
entries.dialogueText: I could see that Emmerich Hegel had a smirk on his face. He seemed confident.

entries.speaker: Ephraim Nines (R)
entries.title: Ephraim Nines (R): ""Thank you, Mr. Prime Minister. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Mr. Prime Minister. The voting will now commence."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""He has a point.""
entries.dialogueText: "He has a point."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Agnolia has no chance. Valgsland w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Agnolia has no chance. Valgsland won't stand for this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He speaks the truth, that's for su..."
entries.dialogueText: "He speaks the truth, that's for sure."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Having a point is not enough. Ther..."
entries.dialogueText: "Having a point is not enough. There is more at play here."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I admire his pride and his bravery..."
entries.dialogueText: "I admire his pride and his bravery. Even if they will not help him here."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""No, they won't. Especially not wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, they won't. Especially not with United Contana backing them up."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""As unfortunate as it is, we've see..."
entries.dialogueText: "As unfortunate as it is, we've seen firsthand how often might makes right."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Nay.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nay."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Aye.""
entries.dialogueText: "Aye."

entries.speaker: Anton Rayne (R)
entries.title: Anton Rayne (R): ""Aye.""
entries.dialogueText: "Aye."

entries.speaker: Anton Rayne (R)
entries.title: Anton Rayne (R): ""Nay.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nay."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Nay.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nay."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Nay.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nay."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Nay.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nay."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Nay.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nay."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Nay.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nay."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Paskal Beniwoll
Dwight Walker (R)
entries.title: Dwight Walker (R): ""Abstain.""
entries.dialogueText: "Abstain."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev (R)
entries.title: Leon Malenyev (R): ""Nay.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nay."

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten (R)
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten (R): ""Aye.""
entries.dialogueText: "Aye."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was finally my turn to cast a vo..."
entries.dialogueText: It was finally my turn to cast a vote.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Aye.""
entries.dialogueText: "Aye."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Nay.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nay."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gasps and hushed whispers circulate..."
entries.dialogueText: Gasps and hushed whispers circulated around the room.

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten (R)
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten (R): ""Thank you for your support, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for your support, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No need to thank me. I only did it..."
entries.dialogueText: "No need to thank me. I only did it because I thought it was right."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Maartin Van Hoorten came over to my..."
entries.dialogueText: Maartin Van Hoorten came over to my side to personally shake my hand.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That was a touching speech.""
entries.dialogueText: "That was a touching speech."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Best of luck.""
entries.dialogueText: "Best of luck."

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten (R)
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten (R): ""Thank you regardless. I won't forg..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you regardless. I won't forget that you stood by our side."

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten (R)
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten (R): ""Thank you. I won't forget that you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you. I won't forget that you stood by our side."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The voting concluded and President..."
entries.dialogueText: The voting concluded and President Nines took his seat.

entries.speaker: Ephraim Nines (R)
entries.title: Ephraim Nines (R): ""By a large margin, the Nays have w..."
entries.dialogueText: "By a large margin, the Nays have won. Helji Island will not be recognized as Agnolian territory."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Defeated, Maartin Van Hoorten shook..."
entries.dialogueText: Defeated, Maartin Van Hoorten shook his head in disbelief.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His shoulders dropped. Who knew how..."
entries.dialogueText: His shoulders dropped. Who knew how he felt in that moment?

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nines signaled for a break. Laurent..."
entries.dialogueText: Nines signaled for a break. Laurento stood up to catch a minister he wanted to talk to.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I enjoyed the Kyrutian circular pas..."
entries.dialogueText: I enjoyed the Kyrutian circular pastry with sesame seeds -- apparently named 'Rekgev' -- that was handed out as a snack as we waited for the session to continue.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He left to talk to his aides."
entries.dialogueText: He left to talk to his aides.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked around the room. The atten..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked around the room. The attendees' attention had begun to flag. A few didn't even bother to disguise their yawns.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The AN recognized Zille as Rizian..."
entries.dialogueText: "The AN recognized Zille as Rizian territory. I suppose he thinks he has a shot."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Yes, although the circumstances su..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, although the circumstances surrounding Helji Island are quite different."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The AN wouldn't even recognize Zil..."
entries.dialogueText: "The AN wouldn't even recognize Zille as Rizian territory. What makes him think he has a shot?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""That's a good question.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's a good question."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Aye.""
entries.dialogueText: "Aye."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Perhaps you will also support me i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps you will also support me in the recognition of Pales as Rizia's rightful territory."

entries.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten (R)
entries.title: Maartin Van Hoorten (R): ""I-- I can't promise anything. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "I-- I can't promise anything. But I won't forget that you stood by our side today."
